item.title: Present a fair venue choice
item.context_text: You help a student society select a venue for an evening event. Both choices have a trade-off that matters to the audience.
item.objective_text: Make a defensible recommendation involving access, capacity, and cost.
success_conditions: Make a defensible recommendation involving access, capacity, and cost.

children.title: Read the situation
children.instructions: Read the information and answer both questions.
children.prompt_text:
VENUE QUOTES
Riverside Room: seventy seats, step-free access, 320,000 som. Garden Loft: ninety seats, stairs only, 280,000 som. Sixty-five people have confirmed, and up to twelve more may come. One confirmed guest needs step-free access. The committee can hire eight overflow seats for Riverside at 3,000 som each. Its budget is 350,000 som.

questions.prompt: What would Riverside cost with the overflow seats?
questions.explanation: Eight seats cost 24,000 som, bringing Riverside's total to 344,000.

questions.prompt: Which selection accommodates both the expected maximum and the access need?
options: Riverside with the standard layout alone
questions.explanation: Riverside has step-free access and reaches 78 seats, one above the potential group of 77.

children.title: Send the committee a recommendation
children.prompt_text: Committee: Which venue should we book and why?
children.instructions: Recommend the option that meets access, capacity, and budget. Name the amount.
children.model_answer: I recommend Riverside with the eight overflow seats. It provides step-free access and has space for up to seventy-eight people, which covers the full expected attendance. The total is 344,000 som, leaving 6,000 som in the budget.

children.title: Respond to a cheaper suggestion
children.prompt_text: Treasurer: Can we save money by using the loft?
children.instructions: Acknowledge the price advantage, then explain the deciding requirement.
children.goal: Trade off cost and access diplomatically.
children.model_answer: I agree the loft is cheaper, but stairs would exclude one confirmed guest. Riverside with the extra seats is within budget and gives everyone a way in.
